item.spudiversity.noname_potato.tooltip: "A potato of strange color. The skin is a silent purple, but a warm yellow peeks from the eyes."
item.spudiversity.noname_potato.tooltip_: "It has no taste, no aroma, yet holding it brings an odd calm, as if holding a heart that no longer beats."
"You are certain it comes from a very important person. Their figure is blurry in your memory, like a never-ending snowstorm. The only thing clear is the words you never said when they left."
"... Eat it. Perhaps you'll find answers, or oblivion."
'Eat it, it's useless, but... it fills the belly.'
A voice echoes in your mind, gender indistinct, carrying a smile and a trace... of barely perceptible weariness.
The voice causes a sharp sting, like an ice pick into your temple, but then comes a huge, suffocating emptiness.
Who are you? Who was I?
That such a silent potato is needed as the last anchor against the inevitable, complete oblivion?
item.spudiversity.noname_potato_dark.too: At the moment the Wither is defeated, the Nameless Potato in your off-hand loses all its luster.
It becomes gray, cold, like an ordinary stone.
It exhausted its power to exchange for fragments of memory — a figure leaving in the snow, an unsaid goodbye.
The thought of End coordinates 0-0-0 surfaces in your mind.
